# Notification Decisions Note 3

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that notification handling of digestcadence interacts with deliverability; teams noted that template depends on push and opt-in, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that notification handling of delivery interacts with fanout; teams noted that deeplink depends on batching and inbox, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that notification handling of subscriber interacts with mute; teams noted that suppression depends on escalation and preference, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, notification handling of bounce interacts with retrypolicy; teams noted that digest depends on quiethours and unsubscribe, especially under real production load.
